about: Yo-kai Watch 4++ is an updated version of Yo-kai Watch 4 with new content for the game, there will be new areas like "Blossom Heights" and “Cauldron-Boiled Hell”, a new Yo-kai to befriend, a new boss and a new multiplayer mode.
